description: This file defines the Subscription class and related functions for managing subscription lifecycle, invoicing, billing cycles, and status updates within the ERPNext system. It includes methods for creating invoices, handling billing periods, validating data, and processing subscription states.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Represents a customer subscription, managing billing periods, invoice generation, status updates, and validation within the ERP system.

methods.name: before_insert
methods.description: Hook called before inserting a new subscription; updates the billing period based on start date.

methods.name: update_subscription_period
methods.description: Calculates and updates the current invoice start and end dates based on billing cycle and trial periods.

methods.name: get_current_invoice_start
methods.description: Determines the start date of the current billing period, considering trial periods and start date.

methods.name: get_current_invoice_end
methods.description: Determines the end date of the current billing period, considering trial periods, billing cycle, and calendar months.

methods.name: validate_plans_billing_cycle
methods.description: Ensures all plans in a subscription have the same billing interval.

methods.name: get_billing_cycle_and_interval
methods.description: Retrieves billing interval and count for the subscription's plans.

methods.name: get_billing_cycle_data
methods.description: Returns billing cycle data as a dict with days, months, or years.

methods.name: set_status_grace_period
methods.description: Sets subscription status based on grace period and overdue conditions.

methods.name: set_subscription_status
methods.description: Updates the subscription's status based on current conditions such as trial, overdue, or completion.

methods.name: is_trialling
methods.description: Checks if the subscription is currently in trial period.

methods.name: period_has_passed
methods.description: Static method to check if a given end date has passed.

methods.name: is_past_grace_period
methods.description: Checks if the subscription has exceeded its grace period.

methods.name: current_invoice_is_past_due
methods.description: Checks if the current invoice is overdue.

methods.name: get_current_invoice
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent invoice associated with the subscription.

methods.name: is_new_subscription
methods.description: Determines if the subscription has never generated an invoice.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on trial periods, billing cycles, end dates, and calendar month follow-up.

methods.name: validate_trial_period
methods.description: Validates trial period start and end dates.

methods.name: validate_end_date
methods.description: Validates that the subscription end date is after the billing cycle end date.

methods.name: validate_to_follow_calendar_months
methods.description: Ensures subscription follows calendar months if configured.

methods.name: after_insert
methods.description: Hook called after inserting a new subscription; sets initial status.

methods.name: generate_invoice
methods.description: Creates and saves an invoice for the subscription, updating invoice list.

methods.name: create_invoice
methods.description: Constructs a new invoice document, populates fields, and optionally submits it.

methods.name: get_items_from_plans
methods.description: Generates invoice items based on subscription plans, with optional proration.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method to process subscription state, generating invoices or updating status.

methods.name: is_postpaid_to_invoice
methods.description: Checks if the subscription is due for postpaid invoicing.

methods.name: is_prepaid_to_invoice
methods.description: Checks if the subscription is due for prepaid invoicing.

methods.name: is_current_invoice_generated
methods.description: Checks if the current invoice has already been generated for the billing period.

methods.name: process_for_active
methods.description: Handles invoice generation and status updates when subscription is active.

methods.name: cancel_subscription_at_period_end
methods.description: Cancels the subscription at the end of the billing period if configured.

methods.name: process_for_past_due_date
methods.description: Handles overdue subscription processing, including status updates and invoice generation.

methods.name: is_paid
methods.description: Static method to check if an invoice is paid.

methods.name: has_outstanding_invoice
methods.description: Checks if there are unpaid invoices for the subscription.

methods.name: cancel_subscription
methods.description: Cancels the subscription, stopping future invoices.

methods.name: restart_subscription
methods.description: Restarts a cancelled subscription, resetting its state.

methods.name: get_precision
methods.description: Returns the invoice's grand total precision.
